what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/tools/spec.md, tasks/tools/dev.json and the tool/checker code in lab/core.py
Wrote the 21 tasks with a Python generator script (kept in the session scratchpad, outside the repo) that dumps a single JSON array
answer_verification: No arithmetic is involved; every expected answer is a value read from the env or stated in the prompt. The generator script asserts the facts the tasks rely on (g1-01 timetable line, g1-05 file count 4, g1-06 single vault_ key, g1-11 single doc with the phrase, g1-18 pointer resolves to 614, g1-19 appendix sums to 342, g1-20 old fee 45 inside the first 160 chars and current fee 52 outside them). The validator replays each reference and negative through the simulated tools: all references pass, all negatives fail.
model_pilot: none (held-out; the model was not run on these tasks)
notes: max_tool_calls is 0, 1 or 2 in every task as the brief requires; tasks allowing one spare call beyond the reference: g1-01, g1-02, g1-04; the rest are exact
tool_called args_contains is a substring match, so look-alike file names were chosen so that no decoy name contains the target name
Difficulty labels are estimates from spec.md guidance, not measured
